The QMP guest_exec command injection lives in the qemu-system monitor protocol. cdi-importer does not include qemu-system, does not start a QMP listener, and never invokes guest_exec; only qemu-utils binaries (qemu-img, qemu-nbd) are present and none expose QMP.

The QMP migrate command injection lives in the qemu-system monitor protocol. cdi-importer does not include qemu-system, does not start a QMP listener, and does not run VM migrations; only qemu-utils binaries (qemu-img, qemu-nbd) are invoked, none of which expose QMP.

The integer overflow is in the QEMU Guest Agent (qga) command handlers. cdi-importer does not install qemu-guest-agent and never runs inside a guest VM; only qemu-utils is present. The qga code path is not reachable.

The flaw is in the QEMU rocker virtual switch device, exposed only by qemu-system when emulating that hardware for a guest VM. cdi-importer ships qemu-utils only (qemu-img, qemu-nbd, qemu-storage-daemon, qemu-io) for disk image conversion; it does not include or invoke any qemu-system binary, so the rocker code path is not present at runtime.

The vulnerability requires ForwardToWall=yes in systemd-journald configuration to forward wall messages with ANSI escape sequences. Containers do not run systemd-journald, making this attack vector inapplicable.
